license_required.quote: A person may not practice or offer to practice professional nursing or vocational nursing in this state unless the person is licensed as provided by this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Texas Board of Nursing.

name.quote: "Board" means the Texas Board of Nursing.

type.quote: The Texas Board of Nursing consists of 15 members appointed by the governor with the advice and consent of the senate

moral_character_required.quote: has good professional character related to the practice of nursing

degree_required.value: Completed program of professional or vocational nursing education (baccalaureate, associate degree, or diploma for RN; approved program for LVN)
degree_required.quote: has successfully completed a program of professional or vocational nursing education approved under Section 301.157(d)

accrediting_body.value: National nursing accrediting agency selected by the board, recognized by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: select one or more national nursing accrediting agencies, recognized by the United States Department of Education and determined by the board to have acceptable standards, to accredit schools of nursing and educational programs

exams.name: NCLEX (National Council Licensure Examination)
exams.notes: Prepared by a national testing service or the board; designed to determine fitness to practice professional or vocational nursing
exams.quote: The examination shall be designed to determine the fitness of the applicant to practice professional nursing or vocational nursing.

exams.name: Jurisprudence Examination
exams.notes: Conducted on licensing requirements under this chapter and board rules and other laws applicable to the nursing profession in this state
exams.quote: has passed the jurisprudence examination approved by the board as provided by Subsection (a-1)

required.quote: the board may require participation in continuing competency programs as a condition of renewal of a license

hours_per_period.quote: The board may not require participation in more than a total of 20 hours of continuing education in a two-year licensing period.

period_years.quote: The board may not require participation in more than a total of 20 hours of continuing education in a two-year licensing period.

value: nursing jurisprudence and nursing ethics (at least 2 hours every third two-year period)
forensic evidence collection (at least 2 hours for emergency room nurses)
older adult or geriatric care (at least 2 hours for applicable nurses)
clinical pharmacology and related pathophysiology (for APRNs with prescriptive authority)
topical_requirements.quote: a license holder shall complete at least two hours of continuing education relating to nursing jurisprudence and nursing ethics before the end of every third two-year licensing period

available.quote: the board may issue a license to practice as a registered nurse or vocational nurse in this state by endorsement without examination to an applicant who holds a registration certificate as a registered nurse or vocational nurse, as applicable, issued by a territory or possession of the United States or a foreign country

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a registration certificate from a territory, possession of the US, or foreign country where the issuing agency required the same general degree of fitness as Texas; or hold a license from another state and submit proof of initial licensing by examination with no suspensions/revocations.
requirements.quote: the board may issue a license to practice as a registered nurse or vocational nurse in this state by endorsement without examination to an applicant who holds a registration certificate as a registered nurse or vocational nurse, as applicable, issued by a territory or possession of the United States or a foreign country if the board determines that the issuing agency of the territory or possession of the United States or foreign country required in its examination the same general degree of fitness required by this state.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice or offer to practice professional nursing or vocational nursing in this state unless the person is licensed as provided by this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Unless the person holds a license under this chapter, a person may not use, in connection with the person's name: (1) the title "Registered Nurse," "Professional Nurse," "Licensed Vocational Nurse," "Vocational Nurse," "Licensed Practical Nurse," "Practical Nurse," or "Graduate Nurse"

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice or offer to practice professional nursing or vocational nursing in this state unless the person is licensed as provided by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of this chapter, a rule or regulation not inconsistent with this chapter, or an order issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice professional nursing or vocational nursing

disciplinary_grounds.quote: a conviction for, or placement on deferred adjudication community supervision or deferred disposition for, a felony or for a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct resulting in revocation of probation imposed because of conviction for a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct that results in the revocation of probation imposed because of conviction for a felony or for a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of a nursing license, diploma, or permit that has been fraudulently purchased, issued, counterfeited, or materially altered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of a nursing license, diploma, or permit, or the transcript of such a document, that has been fraudulently purchased, issued, counterfeited, or materially altered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating or acting as a proxy for another person in the licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: impersonating or acting as a proxy for another person in the licensing examination required under Section 301.253 or 301.255

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly aiding or abetting an unlicensed person in connection with the unauthorized practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: directly or indirectly aiding or abetting an unlicensed person in connection with the unauthorized practice of nursing

disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation, suspension, or denial of, or any other action relating to, the person's license or privilege to practice nursing in another jurisdiction or under federal law

disciplinary_grounds.quote: intemperate use of alcohol or drugs that the board determines endangers or could endanger a patient

disciplinary_grounds.quote: unprofessional conduct in the practice of nursing that is likely to deceive, defraud, or injure a patient or the public

disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to care adequately for a patient or to conform to the minimum standards of acceptable nursing practice in a manner that, in the board's opinion, exposes a patient or other person unnecessarily to risk of harm

definition_quote.value: Professional nursing means the performance of an act that requires substantial specialized judgment and skill, the proper performance of which is based on knowledge and application of the principles of biological, physical, and social science as acquired by a completed course in an approved school of professional nursing. The term does not include acts of medical diagnosis or the prescription of therapeutic or corrective measures.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional nursing" means the performance of an act that requires substantial specialized judgment and skill, the proper performance of which is based on knowledge and application of the principles of biological, physical, and social science as acquired by a completed course in an approved school of professional nursing. The term does not include acts of medical diagnosis or the prescription of therapeutic or corrective measures.

value: observation, assessment, intervention, evaluation, rehabilitation, care and counsel, or health teachings
maintenance of health or prevention of illness
administration of medication or treatment as ordered by a physician, podiatrist, or dentist
administration, supervision, and evaluation of nursing practices, policies, and procedures
requesting, receiving, signing for, and distribution of prescription drug samples (for APRNs)
performance of acts delegated by a physician
development of the nursing care plan
methods_authorized.quote: Professional nursing involves: (A) the observation, assessment, intervention, evaluation, rehabilitation, care and counsel, or health teachings of a person who is ill, injured, infirm, or experiencing a change in normal health processes; (B) the maintenance of health or prevention of illness; (C) the administration of a medication or treatment as ordered by a physician, podiatrist, or dentist

drug_authority.value: APRNs may prescribe or order drugs or devices as delegated by a physician under applicable statutes; must have specialized education including pharmacology and receive a prescription authorization number from the board.
drug_authority.quote: any specialized education or training, including pharmacology, that an advanced practice registered nurse must have to prescribe or order a drug or device as delegated by a physician under Section 157.0512 or 157.054

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) — includes nurse practitioner, nurse midwife, nurse anesthetist, and clinical nurse specialist
license_tiers.quote: The term includes a nurse practitioner, nurse midwife, nurse anesthetist, and clinical nurse specialist.

aprn_role_categories.quote: The term includes a nurse practitioner, nurse midwife, nurse anesthetist, and clinical nurse specialist.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: The practice of vocational nursing must be performed under the supervision of a registered nurse, physician, physician assistant, podiatrist, or dentist.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: any specialized education or training, including pharmacology, that an advanced practice registered nurse must have to prescribe or order a drug or device as delegated by a physician under Section 157.0512 or 157.054

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: a system for issuing a prescription authorization number to an advanced practice registered nurse approved under Paragraph (B)

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: "Nurse aide registry" means a list maintained by the Department of Aging and Disability Services of nurse aides under the Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1987

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: a trainee in a medication aide training program approved by the department under this subchapter who is administering medications as part of the trainee's clinical experience

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Unless the person is practicing under the delegated authority of a registered nurse or is otherwise authorized by state or federal law, a person may not use, in connection with the person's name: (1) the title "nurse aide," "nurse assistant," or "nurse technician"

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: A person that terminates, suspends for more than seven days, or takes other substantive disciplinary action, as defined by the board, against a nurse, or a substantially equivalent action against a nurse who is a staffing agency nurse, because the nurse engaged in conduct subject to reporting shall report in writing to the board

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: A person may not suspend, terminate, or otherwise discipline, discriminate against, or retaliate against: (1) a nurse who refuses to engage in an act or omission as provided by Subsection (a-1)

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: A person who is required to report a nurse under this subchapter because the nurse is impaired or suspected of being impaired by chemical dependency or mental illness may report to a peer assistance program approved by the board under Chapter 467, Health and Safety Code, instead of reporting to the board
